summary: Holistic review fixed quick-mode auth-loss finalization, restored dry-run prerequisite checks, and restricted OpenCode liveness probes; all session requirements now pass.

findings.description: Quick mode detected an agent authentication failure but still entered the deferred test/PR finalizer, which could invoke the unavailable agent again and claim earlier build-only results as shipped.
Moving prerequisite checks into the non-dry liveness path caused dry-runs to stop validating required gh, git, and agent binaries.
The text-only liveness option did not restrict OpenCode, whose default Build agent permits tools; probes now select OpenCode's restricted Plan agent.
pnpm audit reports eight pre-existing vulnerabilities in Jest's development-only transitive dependencies; pnpm audit --prod reports no known production vulnerabilities.
